name: Voice Filter
tagline: Your writing → your voice, on any draft.
description: Upload your writing and it builds a model of your voice — a measured stylistic fingerprint plus eight prompt formats — then rewrites any bland draft to sound like you, with a tone/intensity slider and an inline diff. Built on the Imp taste-transfer engine (800+ scored rewrites of research behind it).
run: pip install flask anthropic && export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-... && python app/server.py
highlights: Multi-file upload + paste to build a voice
8 prompt formats (voice memo, persona, anti-patterns, statistical fingerprint, …)
Tone slider — subtle → full voice (the usability lever from the research)
Side-by-side rewrite with changed words highlighted
